regions.today: Warm and sunny this evening with light or moderate north to northeasterly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry and clear with isolated mist patches possible. Cooler than recent nights, with lowest temperatures of 10 to 12 degrees in a light northerly or variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be another warm and dry day with hazy sunshine. Highest temperatures of 23 to 26 degrees in a light or moderate north to northeasterly breeze.
